name: @trevoralexanderrobey/obsidian-bridge-adapter
description: Stdio MCP adapter that tunnels to a canonical Obsidian bridge daemon (HTTPS + HMAC + replay-guard). Lets any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Qwen Chat, Raycast) talk to one Obsidian bridge instead of running its own — keeping vault access auth-protected and the operator topology unified.
author: Trevor Robey <trevor@trevorobeyinc.com>
